## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe a concrete trigger and change. Use synthetic examples only.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting, Clippy, workspace tests, and release build pass
- [ ] Positive and negative controls cover behavior changes
- [ ] Docs/changelog/contract decisions updated
- [ ] Privacy, dependency, and compatibility risks reviewed
- [ ] No credentials, private traffic, or unlicensed assets

Suspected vulnerabilities belong in a verified private channel; see SECURITY.md.
